cases.prompt: Run proof of execution on collection/skills/create-readme using a small sample project, and the user confirms the record.
assertions: The Po block is appended between PO:BEGIN and PO:END markers only after confirming a clean git state for the skill directory.
The raw record is written outside the repository by default.
After confirmation the Po block is removed and the SKILL.md hash matches the original before the metadata tag is added.
Frontmatter gains metadata.po-verified, po-record-sha256, and po-skill-sha256, and no sidecar is written unless a sanitized copy was approved.

cases.prompt: Run proof of execution on a skill, but the run fails midway and the user rejects the record.
assertions: The Po block is still removed and the file is verified identical to the original.
The raw record is kept outside the repository and no sidecar is created.
Unevidenced claims in the record are marked unverified rather than invented.
